decisions.summary: GROVE_SIDES 5:3:2 and GROVE_SIDES_FLOOD 15:9:16 rolled per settlement, pinnable; flood_ground pinnable else polder archetypes or dike_top; recorded in meta, nucleated included; the generic Settlement rolls the same table
decisions.why: FR-005, FR-006, FR-009 and the nucleated edge case. Extending the roll to the other path that draws a homestead grove is what 'the homestead grove' knob covers.

decisions.summary: grove_faces(windward, sides, flank): two = windward pair (cardinal: face + a per-settlement rolled flank); three adds the non-front face; four adds the front; the front is the yard's face
decisions.why: FR-007 word for word; which flank a cardinal key takes is left open by the spec and rolling it from the seed follows the knob doctrine.

decisions.summary: The dispersed bundle carried from its NW canonical frame to the map's windward key by a symmetry of the square (SE by the anti-diagonal mirror, yard W); in every frame but the identity NW one the garden is laid beside the yard
decisions.why: Within, as round 1 ruled: without turning the bundle FR-007 and FR-010 cannot hold on a map declaring another wind, and moving the garden is forced by FR-010's morning-sun clause. The round-1 wording fix is made: the relocation now applies to every frame but NW, naming the NE mirror's west-wall case.

decisions.summary: Deep bands keep 1.57*hh; a thin band is one crown (17 ft, GUESS); east band set beyond the garden's morning-sun reach, front band beyond the yard's sun corridor; N/S bands full width so corners close
decisions.why: FR-008 leaves the thin depth open (spec Decisions: a GUESS). Setting bands outside the worked ground still plants the side and closes the corners; it is how FR-010's garden-sun and structure rules are met, not a side dropped.

decisions.summary: A four-sided ring's front band broken once at the yard's center for a way in about 36 ft wide (WAY_IN_FT; width a GUESS)
decisions.why: Unchanged in kind from round 1: one opening, on the front the spec names as the way-in side, is what FR-010 (every household seated and reached, no grove on a lane tread) physically requires of a closed ring. The width moved from 12 ft to 36 ft on a measurement (cohort seed 12: at 12 ft no route at cells 10, 5 or 3 and 14 of 17 farms stranded; the router keeps about 22 ft of the opening clear), recorded in dispersed.py and homesteads/715 as a GUESS set by that necessity. Four planted sides remain, so the ring the GM approved is not gutted.

decisions.summary: geom['groves'] list with faces and depth replaces grove_n/grove_w in every reader; a farm is seated only where its whole rolled grove fits
decisions.why: FR-010 and the spec's 'every farm carries its settlement's grove' decision.

decisions.summary: Manifest predicates grove_sides_complete, groves_windward, gardens_east_clear; cohort_audit runs them and the overlap matrix on every roll; a gate seed test on non-nucleated pool rolls
decisions.why: Enforcement of FR-010 and SC-005 only; with the requested behavior deleted there is nothing left for these to check.

decisions.summary: City/house-first path: _grove_room asks room for the minimal footprint of every rolled face; _solve_homestead seats a grove farm only with that room (the yard-and-garden-only fallback removed); _find_grove_arms plants every face grove_faces names; whether a farm has a grove stays the in-wall rule's and grove_prevalence's
decisions.why: Round 1's NOT LEGITIMATE finding is cured: no rolled side is dropped for want of room (FR-010, spec Decisions 'no farm quietly loses sides'), the seat is conditioned on room for the whole rolled grove as D6 does for the bundle, and the grove-or-not decision is untouched as required. An unseated farm follows D6's already-accepted rule. No longer a narrowing.

decisions.summary: Thin band drawn with the dooryard mix, deep bands the windbreak mix (GUESS for the ring)
decisions.why: Spec Decisions: 'Tonami's tall cedar on the windward faces and lesser trees elsewhere'; the species mix is left open to the plan.

decisions.summary: SETTLEMENT_FORMS restored to the 126 weights; comment rewritten
The five pool hamlets regenerate from unchanged specs, taking their seed's form and side count; settlement-review where layout moved

Record rewritten in two write sessions (homesteads 010/710/480; vegetation 030/620), checked by quote-check, record-format, source-applicability; modals by entry-drift; grove modal states the side count
The two nucleated overlaps the matrix found (seeds 17, 20) fixed whether pre-existing or regressions
decisions.why: Not an addition to the request: once the matrix runs in the cohort (D7), SC-005 requires every seed's checks green, and a defect found in the work is fixed under XIV. It narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: rows.py row_line: flood_ground takes edge; else even-odds street/edge knob, pinnable, meta.row_line; edge = the field envelope buffered out (curving arc), street = a straight chord; row length n_side x frame centered on the seat, clipped to the canvas
decisions.why: FR-013 word for word: both attested lines, the site's line on flood ground, even odds otherwise, pinnable and recorded; the straight surveyed street and the margin-following edge are the spec's own forms.

decisions.summary: row_sides knob one/both (even odds, pinnable, meta.row_sides); farms one frame apart; ONE = street between the row and its field, BOTH = near row and far row either side of a street set out from the field; seats center-out; a full line grows a parallel street; the front-row, rank and rescue passes do not run for a linear hamlet
decisions.why: FR-014, FR-015 and FR-016. Switching off the rank and rescue passes enforces FR-013's 'never in ranks behind the row'; the overflow goes to FR-016's parallel street, and FR-010 / SC-005 still require every household seated.

decisions.summary: On BOTH, the far row's holding is behind its lot (street: a strip one frame wide and three deep in the near ring's plots; edge: one frame deep, compact, near the house), RESERVED at seating (placed box + block_polys ring) so later placers keep off; a far farm with no room for its holding is not seated there; only a canvas-edge clip or a single plot on water or a lane is dropped, never the whole holding
decisions.why: Round 1's findings are cured: the holding is behind the lot on both lines, compact and near the house on the edge (homesteads/156), and reserved so it cannot be crowded out. The one narrowing, a plot left undrawn, is taken case by case. A canvas-edge clip is forced by the sheet and is what homesteads/156 says a sheet shows ('only the near end of a 2,240-ft strip'). A single plot under water or a lane cannot be farmed; since the holding is reserved before later placers run, that case arises only where they cannot route round it. The holding itself is always drawn behind the farm, as FR-015 and SC-007 require. Depth and crop are GUESSES the spec already carries.

decisions.summary: Each planned street laid as one width-6 lane (web lanes 3-5), joined to the connector or the previous street; no skeleton arms or web cuts for a linear hamlet with planned streets; each row farm's door path targets its own street, routed round its grove when the street is on the windward side, and records its farm
decisions.why: FR-017 (one continuous way, joined to the connector, a rank wider, every farm reaching it) and FR-019 (the front door reached). Round 1's finding is cured: the way ends on the farm's own street. Leaving out the arms is not a narrowing: the request asks for no arms, and the streets are the lines FR-013 names.

decisions.summary: The dispersed bundle carries its well's seat in its layout (dooryard beside the yard, away from the garden, off the way in), drawn by own_wells; linear row_water knob own/shared (even odds, pinnable, meta.row_water); shared wells beside each street between lots, at least one every floor(reach/frame) farms, the reach the watering rule's 760 ft (WATER_REACH_FT)
decisions.why: FR-018 exactly: the dispersed farm's own well in its dooryard, off its way in (homesteads/200), and the row's water a recorded, pinnable, even-odds knob with shared wells within reach of the farms they serve. Round 1's finding is cured: spacing is taken from the reach, and the layout carries the well, so no farm is seated without water.

decisions.summary: row_rules, water_rules, doors_unreached and bamboo_mismatch predicates; the cohort audit runs them on every roll and adds pinned linear specs covering each value of row_line, row_sides and row_water; the gate test runs them on the linear pool maps
decisions.why: Enforcement of SC-007 and SC-008 clause by clause. Pinned specs make 'both values appear' certain rather than left to the roll. Delete the requested behavior and these checks have nothing left to check, so they enforce the request (GM 2026-09-20).
